authoring_channel: delegated GPT-6 Luna refinement of the original CodexCLI Luna case; not a new harness or provider-CLI trial
brief: Refine the original sandy coastal creek into a plausible shallow channel with a graded bed, irregular contacting banks, proportionate dune vegetation and stones, and clear creekside cameras.
modifications: Carved a 512-segment sand terrain channel from the stream's sampled centerline, width and grade, with the supplied stream bed retained under the water.
Converted world-space stream and bank heights into the offset sand group's local coordinates; added a small shoreline interpolation correction after measuring the actual triangle sampler.
Replaced individually cobble-textured pebble meshes with varied, individually seated makeRock stones, and retained the larger fractured bank rocks.
Rendered and reviewed the same establishing, waterline and bend-detail cameras at 0, 1.5 and 3 seconds on the real GPU.

testing.render_result: 9 authored-camera GPU frames rendered on ANGLE/D3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU); zero console errors, shader errors, update errors or host warnings.

shoreline_measurement.method: Sampled makeSandTerrain.userData.sampleHeight at both horizontal stream ribbon edges and compared world terrain height with makeStream.userData.sample(u, 0, 0) water grade.

testing.staging: Isolated temporary workspace at /tmp/graphics-seven-hour/luna-creek-refinement/staged with copied shipped scene_threejs src/lib modules. Preserved v1 source and renders in /tmp/graphics-seven-hour/luna-creek-refinement/v1; final frames and metrics are in /tmp/graphics-seven-hour/luna-creek-refinement/renders-v3. The original comparison render at /tmp/graphics-seven-hour/integration-preview-1/luna_coastal_creek.png was left unchanged.

library_usability_notes: makeStream.sample(u, lateral, 0) provides the graded centerline and ribbon edge needed to shape terrain along a bend rather than along a fixed world axis.
makeSandTerrain.userData.sampleHeight interpolates the actual rendered triangles, allowing bank contact to be measured and stones and plants to be seated against the edited terrain.
The sand group is vertically offset, so world-space stream targets must be converted back into local heights before writing terrain vertices.
visual_limitations: The result is a stylized procedural coastal creek. The shallow stream remains a smooth kinematic water ribbon and reads somewhat cool and glassy in broad views.
